head: 902a378bf
notes: The round-1 defects are fixed. `if (CD_sync(0, 0) != 2) return -1; return 0;` is SOTN bios.c verbatim and calls CD_sync through its true (s32, u8 *) prototype. The alias is gone: InterruptCallback(2, cdrom_IrqHandler) resolves to 0x80081f1c (build/bb2.map:2144). g_cd_reg0..3 and g_com_delay_reg were verified against the EXE words 0x1F801800..803 and 0x1F801020, and each use matches its index role. No asm, no unlabelled no-purpose construct, no second handle. The *(s32 *)&CD_status merged-TU view is disclosed (system.c:362) and is hygiene debt.
